subject: maths
question: The price of fuel decreases by 35%, 60% and 10% in three successive months but increases by 65% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net factor = 0.65 × 0.40 × 0.90 × 1.65

= 0.234 × 1.65

= 0.3861

Change = 0.3861 − 1 = −0.6139

**∴ Answer = 61.39% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −35%, −60%, −10%, +65%

**Formula used:**

Net effect = Product of successive multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 1st month: multiply by (1 − 35/100) = 0.65

⇒ After 2nd month: multiply by (1 − 60/100) = 0.40

⇒ After 3rd month: multiply by (1 − 10/100) = 0.90

⇒ After 4th month: multiply by (1 + 65/100) = 1.65

⇒ Net multiplier = 0.65 × 0.40 × 0.90 × 1.65

⇒ = 0.234 × 1.65

⇒ = 0.3861

⇒ Final price = 0.3861 of original

⇒ Percentage change = (0.3861 − 1) × 100

⇒ = −61.39%

**∴ The correct answer is 61.39% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Net effect = (1 + a/100)(1 + b/100)(1 + c/100)...

Decrease Conversion

Decrease of x% ⇒ multiply by (1 − x/100)

Increase Conversion

Increase of x% ⇒ multiply by (1 + x/100)

Final Change Formula

% change = (Final − Original) ÷ Original × 100
